name: folderpreview
description: Foldview — a friendly terminal home for projects, local apps, and AI coding agents. A zero-dependency terminal workspace and launchpad for vibe coding: a 🚦 Launch menu pinned to the top, AI terminals (open 1-9 Terminal windows running a detected or custom AI coding CLI), plus lines of code, disk/package size, language breakdown, git status, and live-localhost detection.
